mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base (owner_user_id, name, description, status) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_user_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, owner_user_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM knowledge_base WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
